# EGM Drift Report — grabbit `CONTEXT.md` contracts

**Date:** 2026-11-22
**Scope:** the 13 `CONTEXT.md` contract files generated by the `egm-bootstrap` run over
`/home/luci/projects/go/grabbit` (target filename `CONTEXT.md`).
**Method:** four parallel `egm-codebase-details` auditors verified every contract in both
directions — doc-to-code (every documented symbol, signature, default, count, format
string, and line citation re-checked against source) and code-to-doc (exported symbols
and behaviors absent from the contracts). Only divergences are listed below.
**Note:** a separate correction pass performed *during* bootstrap final verification
(also recorded here for the audit trail) fixed a systematic doc-to-code error before
this report: four example contracts claimed grabbit "re-declares durable topology on
reconnection recovery"; the code (`channel.go:336`: `if !t.Declare || (recovering &&
t.Durable) { continue }`) skips durable elements during recovery and re-declares only
non-durable declared elements. Affected contracts were corrected at that time. **Addendum (2026-11-22, post-interview):**
the author has since confirmed the intended behavior is recreate-all — see
[docs/adr/0003-recovery-redeclares-all-declared-topology.md](docs/adr/0003-recovery-redeclares-all-declared-topology.md).
The skip-durable code path is a known deviation pending fix, not a contract: the
corrections below made the contracts match the code as it exists, and their
intent-framing is superseded by the ADR.

All findings below were **resolved in-place** during this run (the contracts are files
this bootstrap created); each bullet records the finding, its evidence, and the fix.

## CONTEXT.md (repository root)

- 🔴 Blocker — the System Verification section stated the CI command as
  `go test -tags test_env -coverprofile coverage.out -v ./...`, citing
  `.github/workflows/coverage.yaml`. The workflow actually runs
  `go test -tags test_env -coverprofile coverage.out -v` (coverage.yaml:16-17) with **no
  package pattern**, so CI tests only the current-directory root package; `internal/traceutils`
  is not a CI test target. *Resolved:* the contract now quotes the verbatim command, flags the
  scope limitation, and lists `go test -tags test_env ./...` as the local all-packages variant.
- 🟡 Major — the Side Effects section claimed the safe wrappers call `internal/traceutils`
  "beside **every** AMQP operation". `Close`, `Cancel`, `Reject`, `Ack`, and `Nack` perform
  AMQP operations with no trace hooks (channel_safewrappers.go:26-86; no counterparts exist in
  trace_params_nop.go / trace_params_testing.go). *Resolved:* the bullet now enumerates which
  operation groups have trace counterparts and names the five untraced wrappers.
- Nit — the System Overview attributed retry-veto power to all three callbacks
  "(Down / Up / Recovering … by returning `false`)"; `CallbackWhenUp` is `func(name string)`
  with no return value (general_options.go:70) and cannot veto. *Resolved:* rephrased to
  "Down / Recovering … plus the no-return Up".
- Nit (missing coverage) — exported `SafeBool` (events.go:9-12), unused elsewhere in the
  package, was absent from the contract. *Resolved:* added to the concurrency-primitives
  inventory with its unused status noted.
- Nit (missing coverage) — `PublisherUsageOptions` / `ConsumerUsageOptions` were never named,
  and the `IsConsumer: true` default (consumer_options.go:45) — the flag gating whether a
  channel consumes and spawns the `gobble` loop (channel_notifiers.go:51-57) — was missing
  from the `DefaultConsumerOptions()` inventory. *Resolved:* both structs and the flag are now
  documented.
- Nit (missing coverage) — `go.uber.org/goleak v1.3.0` (go.mod:9; `goleak.VerifyTestMain` in
  container_setup_test.go:19,185) was omitted from dependencies. *Resolved:* added to the
  header as a test-only dependency.
- Nit (missing coverage) — recovery-loop constants were undocumented: the hard-coded
  `delayer.Delay(3)` backoff on notifier-acquisition failure (connection.go:202;
  channel.go:159) and the 120-second anti-hot-loop timer per iteration (connection.go:229;
  channel.go:197). *Resolved:* folded into the recovery-control-flow invariant.
- Nit (missing coverage) — constructor default seeding was undocumented: `NewConnection`
  defaults (unbuffered `chan Event`, name `conn.default`, `context.Background()` —
  connection.go:68-73) and `NewChannel`'s inheritance of the connection's
  notifier/delayer/ctx with default name `chan.default` (channel.go:74-82). *Resolved:* new
  "Constructor defaults & inheritance" invariant added.
- Nit (missing coverage) — the `Notify*` wrappers' failure mode when the base channel is
  unset (they **close the caller-supplied channel(s)**, channel_safewrappers.go:300-361)
  was missing. *Resolved:* new invariant bullet added.
- Nit (missing coverage) — the second CI workflow `.github/workflows/codeql.yml` (CodeQL Go
  analysis, push/PR to `main` + weekly) was omitted from System Verification. *Resolved:*
  added.

  command is now labeled as the local whole-module variant with the CI scope noted.

  `CallbackWhenUp` functions with no return value (channel/main.go:21-23, 35-37). *Resolved:*

- Nit — the abort-on-`false` evidence cited only `general_options.go:157-159`
  (`callbackAllowedRecovery`); the Down path is `callbackAllowedDown` at
  general_options.go:165-167. *Resolved:* both functions cited.
- Nit — the dependency caveat omitted the replaced module's `go 1.25.7` toolchain
  requirement. *Resolved:* added.
